analyticalMisses.summary: Milwaukee was the clearest same-game concentration miss: MIL ML -$10 and MIL 4+ -$25, combined -$35.

analyticalWins.summary: Profit came from multiple market families (team totals, moneylines, pitcher Ks, F5) instead of one concentrated thesis -- the most diversified profitable day of the six reconciled.

Bennett 5+, McLean 6+, Drohan 5+ (3-0) suggest selecting a strikeout ladder near the modal expected outcome may be preferable to stretching for high plus-money rungs. Do not overgeneralize from 3-0 -- family not yet proven.
F3 Tie lost, but its modest stake and plus-money structure were preferable to paying heavy protected-F5 juice merely for tie insurance -- a process point independent of the loss.

gameLevelConcentration.note: Clearest same-game concentration miss: MIL ML -$10, MIL 4+ -$25, combined -$35.

performanceByMarketFamily.note: Winning team totals spread across multiple teams/games (BAL, PHI, BOS, ATH, MIA, MIL, CHC, AZ, SD, MIN, LAD legs mixed W/L) -- more encouraging than one correlated cluster.
BOS ML, SD ML, CLE ML won; MIL ML lost.
Bennett 5+, McLean 6+, Drohan 5+ all won -- each priced near the modal expected strikeout outcome rather than a stretched high plus-money rung. Do not declare the family proven from 3-0.
MIA F5 YES won (+18.55); TB/BAL F5 NO-BAL closed early for a realized -2.84 (paid 9.16 of 2 risk) -- held-to-settlement result not inferred.
F3 Tie lost, but the modest stake and plus-money structure were preferable to paying heavy protected-F5 juice merely for tie insurance.
3-leg combo PHI 4+ / BAL 4+ / MIA 4+. Two legs won; a combo pays only if every leg wins, so the full stake was lost.

processErrors.summary: The 3-leg parlay (PHI 4+/BAL 4+/MIA 4+) duplicated straight PHI 4+ and BAL 4+ exposure and was moderately correlated with MIA F5 via MIA 4+. Parlays should remain small and should not quietly increase major straight-position exposure unless intentionally tagged. Now canonically linked: two of its three legs won and it still lost the entire stake, which is the concrete cost of packaging a duplicated thesis.

proposedInvestigations.summary: Continue tracking whether selecting strikeout ladders near modal expectation outperforms stretching for high plus-money; preserve GitHub issue #43 limitation (player props archived/researchable, manually-confirmed settlement only, no automatic settlement).

earlyClosePositions.detail: TB vs BAL F5, NO on Baltimore wins F5 (economic exposure while held: TB leads or ties after five). Risk $22, closed-position paid out $19.16, realized P/L -$2.84. Represented via executionStatus=SOLD_EARLY / exitSaleProceeds=19.16 (lib.edgelab.bets schema) rather than a binary settlement -- the held-to-settlement counterfactual is deliberately never inferred.

economics.note: stake is the user's whole-dollar commitment, per placed_bet.schema.json's canonical stake definition ('the user's own whole-dollar intent ... NOT a Kalshi share-card Initial cost display value'). The raw $9.99 Initial Cost is preserved verbatim in shareCardEvidence. NO FEE IS EVIDENCED and none was invented: the one-cent gap is consistent with whole-contract rounding leaving budget undeployed, and every fee/cost field is left null exactly as on the three same-date straight rows whose Initial Cost also sat a cent below a whole-dollar stake (24.99/25, 29.99/30, 24.99/25). entryPrice is null because no executed combo price is evidenced; it was NOT derived from max payout / initial cost.
